messages.author: 12b039c03111df43
messages.subject: Former World Maps?
parts:
Dear fellow rworldmap users,

Has anyone implemented a former map of the world, say from the relatively stable period 1949-1990, for example 1974 when the ISO 3166-1 was first published? This would be very useful when plotting historical data from this period. I understand that a lot of maps would be needed to cover the volatile 1990s and the time before 1949, but a few maps would cover the four decades between.

Any thoughts?


Best regards,


Magnus Palmblad

Leiden University
